Title: All I have is an image of you and that's okay
Name: Ally Ivanova
Written Heritage: I've never met my grandfather because he abandoned his family while my mom was still young. This is the first photo that I ever saw of him when I was 19, it's him and my grandma on the left. It was a really weird sensation because as soon as I saw the picture I realised I looked like him. I don't know that much about him apart from the fact that he was a con artist, a prick and that we share love for reading. I'm okay with looking like him on the outside, but I wouldn't want to be anything like him otherwise.
